title: Binary length bound for a scaled power of two
statement: For all natural numbers $C,c,n,m$ with $n\le m$, the length of the binary expansion of $C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}$ is at most $(m+1)^c$ plus the length of the binary expansion of $C$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C, c, n, m$ with $n \le m$, the binary expansion of $C \cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}$ has length at most $(m+1)^c$ plus the length of the binary expansion of $C$.
